surface_name: Vercel CDN cache for function responses
title: Vercel never caches an API route response even though it sets Cache-Control max-age
symptoms: x-vercel-cache: MISS on every request to a function
Cache-Control: max-age=3600 reaches the browser but the function runs each time
s-maxage set by the function is missing from the response the browser sees
cause: The Vercel CDN only stores function responses that carry s-maxage (or a CDN-Cache-Control or Vercel-CDN-Cache-Control header). Responses with set-cookie, private, no-store, or requests with an Authorization header are never cached, and Vercel strips s-maxage before the browser.
fix: Return s-maxage with stale-while-revalidate, or a Vercel-CDN-Cache-Control header, and make sure the route sets no cookie.
affected: Vercel CDN, all plans, as of October 2026
